questions.q: Who assigns names to cyclones forming over the north Indian Ocean?
questions.explanation: **IMD's RSMC New Delhi** names them from a list drawn up by the WMO/ESCAP Panel's 13 member countries.

questions.q: How many seats of the US House of Representatives were contested in the 3 Nov 2026 midterms?
questions.explanation: All **435** House seats; 35 of 100 Senate seats and 36 Governorships were also contested.

questions.q: Who is the Prime Minister of Bangladesh (Nov 2026)?
questions.explanation: **Tarique Rahman**; India has invited him to visit New Delhi.

questions.q: The India-Bangladesh Joint Rivers Commission was set up in:
questions.explanation: In **1972**. The Ganga Treaty (1996) covers sharing at the **Farakka Barrage**.

questions.q: On the CPCB scale, an AQI of 350 falls in which category?
questions.explanation: **301-400 is 'very poor'**; 401-450 severe; 451-500 severe plus.

questions.q:
Consider the following:
1. The Public Accounts Committee of Parliament has 22 members.
2. By convention, its chairperson is from the ruling party.
Which is/are correct?
questions.explanation: Only 1: the PAC has **22 members** (15 LS + 7 RS), and since **1967** its chair has been from the **Opposition**.

questions.q: Tigress 'Dooars Rani' was relocated to Buxa Tiger Reserve (West Bengal) from which reserve?
questions.explanation: From **Valmiki Tiger Reserve** (West Champaran, Bihar); she strayed into Assam's Raimona National Park.

questions.q: The Kotia group of villages, disputed between Odisha and Andhra Pradesh, is in which district of Odisha?
questions.explanation: **Koraput**; the SC ordered status quo in 2006.

questions.q: Who is the Director General of the ITBP (Nov 2026)?
questions.explanation: **Shatrujeet Singh Kapoor**; he confirmed face-offs with the PLA in Arunachal Pradesh.

questions.q: The India-China agreement on Maintenance of Peace and Tranquillity along the LAC was signed in:
questions.explanation: **1993**; the 1996 agreement added confidence-building measures and the 2005 one set political parameters.

questions.q: Who became Myanmar's President after the January 2026 election?
questions.explanation: Junta chief **Min Aung Hlaing**.

questions.q: The Kaladan Multi-Modal project connects Kolkata to which Myanmar port?
questions.explanation: **Sittwe**, then by river to Paletwa and road to Mizoram.

questions.q: The 2026 'Mecca Agreement' security alliance includes Saudi Arabia, Türkiye and:
questions.explanation: **Pakistan**; signed in August 2026.

questions.q: Under Section 27 of the RTE Act, teachers may be deployed for non-educational purposes ONLY for:
options: Disaster relief and mid-day meal audits
questions.explanation: Only **census, disaster relief and election** duties.

questions.q: Article 21A (right to education) was inserted by which Constitutional Amendment?
questions.explanation: The **86th Amendment (2002)**; the RTE Act took effect on 1 April 2010.

questions.q: Which case linked the right to livelihood with the right to life under Article 21?
questions.explanation: **Olga Tellis v. Bombay Municipal Corporation (1985)**, the pavement-dwellers case.

questions.q: Which is NOT a criterion for a 'census town'?
options: Density of at least 400 per sq km
At least 75% of male workers in non-agricultural work
questions.explanation: A census town has **no** notified municipal body; it qualifies on population, density and non-farm male work.

questions.q: How many functions are listed for municipalities in the Twelfth Schedule?
questions.explanation: **18** (the Eleventh Schedule lists 29 for panchayats).

questions.q: The 'rarest of rare' doctrine for the death penalty was laid down in:
questions.explanation: **Bachan Singh v. State of Punjab (1980)**, a Constitution Bench.

questions.q:
Assertion (A): The 262nd Law Commission Report (2015) recommended abolishing the death penalty for all offences.
Reason (R): It found the death penalty did not deter crime more than life imprisonment.
options: Both A and R are true, and R explains A
Both A and R are true, but R does not explain A
A is true, R is false
A is false, R is true
questions.explanation: A is false: it kept the death penalty for **terrorism-related offences**. R is true: it found no greater deterrent effect.

questions.q: Who is the Director-General of UNESCO (2026)?
questions.explanation: **Khaled El-Enany** of Egypt; HQ Paris.

questions.q: The 16th Finance Commission recommended grants of about how much for panchayats for 2026-31?
questions.explanation: **₹4,35,236 crore** for 2.55 lakh panchayats and traditional local bodies.

questions.q: Which author of 'The Vegetarian' won the 2024 Nobel Prize in Literature?
questions.explanation: **Han Kang**, who also won the International Booker in 2016.

questions.q: Where is COP31 (Nov 2026) being held?
questions.explanation: **Antalya, Türkiye**, 9-20 Nov 2026.

questions.q: COP30 (2025) was held at:
questions.explanation: **Belém, Brazil**. COP29 was at Baku and COP28 at Dubai.

questions.q: Tata Motors completed the acquisition of which commercial-vehicle maker in Nov 2026?
questions.explanation: **Iveco Group** of Italy, for **€3.8 billion**; HQ stays in Turin.

questions.q: Who is the chairman of the State Bank of India (Nov 2026)?
questions.explanation: **C.S. Setty**.

questions.q: By which date must general insurers offer a four-layer motor policy for new vehicles, per IRDAI?
questions.explanation: **15 December 2026**.

questions.q: PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana aims to install rooftop solar in how many households?
questions.explanation: **1 crore** households, with up to **300 units** of free electricity a month.

questions.q: Who is the CEO of Air India (Nov 2026)?
questions.explanation: **Tewolde Gebremariam**.

questions.q: Under the 2016 US-Israel MoU signed by Obama, Israel was to receive how much military aid over 10 years?
questions.explanation: **$38 billion** (about $3.8 billion a year).

questions.q: Abdulla Shahid of the Maldives served as President of which UN General Assembly session?
questions.explanation: The **76th session (2021-22)**.

questions.q: Prema Rawat set the record for the fastest fifty in women's T20 cricket in how many balls?
questions.explanation: **14 balls**, for Uttarakhand.

questions.q: Which Indian swimmer won bronze in the 100m freestyle at the 2026 Youth Olympic Games?
questions.explanation: **Dhinidhi Desinghu** (56.27s); judoka Khushbu Rajakbhai won silver.

questions.q: Velavan Senthilkumar won the Czech Open in which sport?
questions.explanation: **Squash**: his 12th PSA Tour title.

questions.q: Who holds the record for the highest individual score in ODIs (264)?
questions.explanation: **Rohit Sharma** (264 v Sri Lanka); he also has three ODI double hundreds.

questions.q: India's first overseas Test series win was against which country, in 1968?
questions.explanation: **New Zealand**, 3-1 under **Pataudi**; the first win came at Dunedin.

questions.q: Under the ODI ball rule introduced in 2025, two new balls are used until which over?
questions.explanation: Until the **34th over**; then one ball is used for the rest of the innings.

questions.q: Green firecrackers (SWAS, STAR, SAFAL) were developed by:
questions.explanation: **CSIR-NEERI** (Nagpur); they cut particulate emissions by about 30%.

questions.q:
Consider the following about the 16th Finance Commission:
1. It raised urban local bodies' share of local-body grants to 45%.
2. It created a ₹10,000-crore 'urbanisation premium' for merging peri-urban villages into municipalities.
Which is/are correct?
questions.explanation: Both are correct, as reported by WRI India's analysis.

questions.q: Under which provision can an ERO act against a false declaration in an electoral roll form?
questions.explanation: **Section 31 of the RP Act, 1950**; the ECI said re-enrolling via Form 6 is not by itself a false declaration.

questions.q: Who is the chairman of Parliament's Public Accounts Committee (2026)?
questions.explanation: **K.C. Venugopal** (Congress); the PAC chair is from the Opposition by convention.

questions.q: Who is the President of Iran (Nov 2026)?
questions.explanation: **Masoud Pezeshkian**; Ghalibaf is the chief negotiator with the US.

questions.q:
Assertion (A): Iran welcomed the outreach of the 'Mecca Agreement' alliance.
Reason (R): Iran prefers region-led security arrangements over US-led ones.
options: Both A and R are true, and R explains A
Both A and R are true, but R does not explain A
A is true, R is false
A is false, R is true
questions.explanation: Both are true and R explains A: Tehran seeks a place in every regional security conversation.
